_comment: Copy to '.lz-playbook.json' at your project root and edit. Consumed by the lz-playbook skills (handoff, pickup, create-issue, issues, doc-*, implementation) so they adapt to each project. All keys optional; the defaults below match a GitHub + gh-issue-sync setup. If the file is present but a key a skill needs is missing, the skill stops and asks rather than silently defaulting.
